_comment: Scene for the selected-army screen. Renderer keys: 'windows' with 'at' (where the engine puts each top-level window on a 2560x1440 screen; leave it out to use the file's own position until it is measured with render_gui.py --verify), 'rows' and 'listRows' (sample rows per list), 'height', 'hide' and 'place' (what the code sizes, hides or moves in this state); 'samples' (texts for named text boxes). Harness keys: 'setup' (recipe steps from the clean state; see wiki/Game-Recipes.md), 'captures' (extra named captures with their own steps), 'expect' (widgets that must be visible in the capture: proof that the recipe brought the screen up), 'crop' (x, y, width, height cut out of a capture). 'manual' and 'checklist' are what is left for a human.

windows.name: army_division_list_view
windows._note: Measured with render_gui.py --verify on a game capture: the toolbar sits at y 187 + its file position. The frame itself starts at the top of the badge (y 83) and runs behind it; the code hides hq_window unless an HQ can be deployed and shows bottom_window only for the unassigned list. A9 (2026-10-16): the badge is 31 px taller (128); the code is expected to put the list under it, at 218 (not yet seen in the game). A2 redesign (2026-10-16): rows of 44 [GUL-043], 22 cards drawn (271 + 22 x 44 = 1239); the code stretches the frame to them (to about 1240 in game), the render keeps the file's 760. Fix round 1 (2026-10-16): rows of 50 (card 48), 19 cards drawn (271 + 19 x 50 = 1221).

windows.name: army_division_view
windows._note: A row window, listed for its hide list and frames: the markers the code hides on a 1936 German division, and the selected card (frame 2), as every division of a selected army is selected.

windows.name: unit_template_entry
windows._note: A dropdown entry, listed for its hide list: German 1936 templates have no priority, no flag and no command power cost.

windows.name: army_badge_view
windows._note: army_color_button is hidden by the code unless a colour is being picked.

manual: Tooltips and click targets (the row's tooltips are set in code)

States a 1936 start does not show: combat entries (the second spilling out), low supply, attrition, exile and colonial frames, the flag, the reinforce priority chevron, the medal indicator, the fake-intel indicator, the HQ bar and its dropdown
checklist: Division list: 50 px cards, one army shows about 19 before it scrolls (count them, and note where the list ends)
Scroll the list to the end: the scrollbar steps by one card
Selected card: dark tile with the green wash and the green rail; deselect one division (ctrl+click) and see the hatch

Each card: bars on the left, template tile with the icon inside the card, level with its bar under it, the name whole on line 1, the warning tray on line 2 (no-orders mark) ending before the preparation bar, which shows on its own background, then acclimatisation and fuel; the experience bar, the warning marks and the entrenchment bar inside the card, the spade over its bar, the army shield in its slot
Sort heads: captions Template, Exp., Name; icons on Warning, Fuel, Status (spade), Army (shield); each sorts its column
Open the change-template dropdown: card entries of 44, names on one line, up to 13 before it scrolls
If an HQ can be deployed: the HQ bar at the list's width, the template name whole, the cost at the right end; open its dropdown (cards over the HQ plate, nothing of the plate showing between them)
Tooltips of the moved markers and click targets of the tile, the medal and the shield

states.name: every-marker
states._note: Every marker the code can show on a row, all at once, and two combat entries (the second spills out of the card): checks that each has its own slot. Not a state the game shows.

states.name: unassigned
states._note: The unassigned list: the close button in the shield's slot, moving instead of dug in.

states.name: hq
states._note: An HQ can be deployed: the HQ bar at y -37 of the content. The render draws it where the file puts it; the code is expected to move the toolbar down by the bar (GUL-012, not seen).

states.name: hq-dropdown
states._note: The HQ deploy dropdown opened: five card entries. In the game the code puts GFX_army_hq_dropdown_button (198x58) on each entry's Background, behind the card (GUW-037).
